title: Resilient Jacksonville - Jacksonville, United States of America
landscapes: Healthcare, Household, Occupational, Tropical and Subtropical, Urban
description: Resilient Jacksonville addresses questions of climate risks and identifies specific and implementable actions that will strengthen the city’s resilience by fostering healthier communities and environments. Resilient Jacksonville includes 45 Actions and 90 Sub-Actions organized by the scales at which the actions are intended to be implemented—Systems, Sites, and People.
